motion_rule: the camera travels sideways parallel to him all clip, the stall row tearing past every beat, his face to the lens; shot size never wider than waist-up, new each beat; one action per beat, the hero always driving it; the tall frame filled, no bars
character: a fennec fox with huge radar ears and a naive face, muzzle free of paws and props
second_characters: ONE meerkat promoter with a card on his shoulder; ONE macaque cashier hauling his strap; both huge at the lens, touching him
props: ONE box-backpack on straps behind his back, a golden mountain painted on its side, opening downward at his hip
prop_continuity: one box only, on his straps to 4.20, then at his hip until he throws it at 8.45; one card; one voucher inside
environment: a promenade at noon, a long row of lottery stalls, drums, flags, umbrellas and animals packed both sides
light_events: flat noon sun, cold bounce off the left awnings, warm kick off the right umbrellas

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, matter-of-fact, biting off each word, 4.4 syllables/sec, beats filled
audio.pronunciation: ko-ROB-ka, o-be-SHCHA-la, zo-lo-TY-ye, GO-ry, KA-zhet-sya, GDE-to, za ug-LOM
audio.pacing: 0.40-3.55 and 5.30-7.75 each one breath; after 7.75 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his jaw opens wide and his lips shape every syllable, brows and jaw alive, muzzle clear of paws and props, never a voice over
audio.sfx: coins from a slot, stall drums, crowd chatter, cardboard into the machine

timeline.a: he tears in from the left at full run, the painted box on his back
he jerks a thumb back at the mountain painted on the box without breaking stride
he sweeps along the row as a jet of coins blasts from a return machine slot ahead of him
he flicks a landed coin off his ear forward down the row as he runs on
he skids sideways along the stalls after a wave of coins rolling forward past him
he takes the meerkat onto his shoulder and rips his head out of its paws, the card shoved past his ear, and slides on
he slides on past the stalls and yanks the pack to his hip, the lid flipping open away from his face on air and one voucher
he flings the voucher sideways into the crowd and slides on along the row
he hauls on as the macaque catches the empty strap and digs her heels in behind him
he drags both of them forward, paws scraping stone, coins flying at his chest
he sights the machine down the row and drives at it, shouldering a flag off a stall
he vaults a spinning drum in his path without breaking stride
he drives his muzzle into the lens with two bodies swinging off him
he ducks the card the meerkat shoves into the lens and it misses his muzzle
he hurls his own empty box across the frame into the return machine, face into the lens
he catches a bounced coin in his teeth as the macaque grabs air at his shoulder

must_appear: the mountain painted on the box; at 4.20 it opens empty on one voucher; the coins come from the machine, never the box; at 8.45 he hurls the box into it; his jaw wide open on every line
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, a parked camera, a hero speaking with his back to the lens, a held pose, a closed muzzle while speaking, a paw over his mouth, a prop against his mouth, a camera pulling back, duplicate props, gold coming out of the box, a word not in the lines, cyrillic letters, readable text, extra limbs
